notes: Crowded; man in yellow beanie stands at the right edge most of the minute, no clear crossings seen.
Bearded man in cap and glasses appears at the right edge in the bottom row, possibly a new arrival; people standing at the edge make it uncertain.
Crowd gathers facing left with backs to camera; people standing at the right edge, no crossings seen.
Door leaf shows twice late in the top row with a grey-haired man at it; crowd thins in the middle row but who went out the door is unclear.
Man in brown beanie, woman in black coat with red bag, and probably a bearded man in cap leave through one long door opening; the third is uncertain.

Man in red jacket and woman in navy jacket clearly enter through the door; in the bottom row the black-coat woman with red bag (left earlier) and at least one other appear on the right with no door swing seen, so those are uncertain.
Person in fur-trimmed hood and orange beanie moves to the right edge in the top row and may have left; people stand at the right edge for the rest of the minute.
Group enters during one long door opening (woman in bandana, person with paper bag, person in blue beanie); a person stands at the right edge through the top row.
Masked man in blue cap, black-coat woman with red bag and woman in fur-trimmed hood leave through one door opening; room is much emptier afterwards so others may have left unseen.
People close to the camera hide the right edge; black-coat woman with red bag seen leaving in 22680 is back inside by the middle row, entry itself not seen.
Long hair close to the camera hides part of the view for several tiles; movement seen is from the left side only.
Man in dark jacket and cap walks to the right edge in the top row and is gone next tile; no door leaf seen, and a head close to the camera blocks part of the view.
Woman in grey coat reaches the right edge at the last tile but is still in view.
Woman in grey-brown coat appears to step out at the first brief swing and come back at the second with a person in a red hat; man close to camera hides the lower left of each tile.

Woman in light coat appears beside the right edge late in the top row, greeted by a woman in orange; a curly-haired woman in black stands on the right in the bottom row, origin unseen; man close to camera blocks much of the view.
One door opening in the top row with a black-haired woman and a person in a beanie at the door, read as entering; direction is uncertain because the man close to camera hides the floor area.
Man in cap and olive jacket appears at the right edge late in the bottom row and a second capped head is at the edge in the last tile; no door leaf seen.
A man in a cap shows at the right edge for one tile in the middle row, direction unknown; otherwise people standing near the right edge without crossing.

Man in grey cap enters at the right edge early in the top row; man in tan cap and scarf enters in the middle row and is hugged by the woman in orange; a person in a grey beanie ends the strip standing at the right edge.

Man in brown jacket enters at the door opening in the top row; a curly-haired woman in dark clothes appears from the right in the bottom row (less certain); the beanie person standing at the edge at the end of 23280 is gone and may have left unseen.
Man in brown jacket near the right edge in the first tile is gone by the second and may have left; no door leaf seen; a woman close to the camera hides the lower left.
Bearded man in grey beanie with white bag browses near the right edge, then seems to sit or crouch there (feet visible) rather than leave.
Long-haired man in black coat and a woman with wavy light hair enter together at the door opening in the top row.

A group pours in at a long door opening in the top row (man in brown beanie, bearded man in black cap, others in dark jackets) and more at a second opening at the end of the middle row; overlapping dark figures make the exact number an estimate, roughly 5 to 7.
Man in mustard beanie stands right in front of the camera for most of the minute; no crossings visible in the gaps.
Person in red beanie heads toward the right edge in the last two tiles but is still in view at the end.

Door opens in the last three tiles and a group starts coming in (about three figures visible at and behind the leaf); the group continues into 23820. Person in red beanie stands at the right edge through the middle row without leaving.

Continuation of the group entry begun at the end of 23760; room fills with new people (bald man in green jacket, woman in tan coat, man in cap and glasses) but heads close to the camera hide the edge, so the split between the two strips and the total (roughly 5 to 7 over both) are estimates.
Person in blue beanie stands at the right edge all minute and a group gathers in front of the camera; no crossings or door leaf seen.
Group standing directly in front of the camera hides the right edge for the whole minute; no door leaf seen above their heads.

Group in front of the camera hides the edge for the top two rows; door opens at the end of the middle row with a tall person in a brown beanie and a dark-haired woman in grey heading to it, read as leaving but direction is uncertain.

Man in grey cap stands directly in front of the camera; door opens at the end of the middle row and a bearded man in a brown beanie comes in, possibly the same person seen at the door in 24000; anyone with him is hidden.
Man in grey cap blocks most of the view; door opens in the bottom row just after a man in a brown beanie and a dark-haired woman reach the right edge, read as the two stepping out.

Door opens early in the bottom row and the bearded man in a brown beanie walks in with a dark-haired person, apparently the pair who stepped out in 24120; top two rows partly blocked by the man in the grey cap.
People pouring drinks right in front of the camera hide the right edge almost all minute; no door leaf seen above them.
Top row partly blocked by people at the drinks; edge is clear for the middle and bottom rows with no crossings.

Bearded man in grey beanie with white bag walks to the right edge and waits there; a dark-haired woman appears beside him mid-strip and he embraces her, read as her arriving though no door leaf was seen.
